question: Who was the Chairman of the Fifteenth Finance Commission of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**NK Singh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **NK Singh was appointed as the Chairman of the Fifteenth Finance Commission of India in November 2017.**
 
• The Fifteenth Finance Commission of India was constituted in **November 2017.**
 
• Its main task was to recommend the sharing of taxes between the central government and the state governments for a five-year period starting from April 2020.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vijay Kelkar** was the Chairman of the **Thirteenth** Finance Commission of India.

 
 
• **He is a renowned economist and policy advisor who has also served as the Finance Secretary of India.**
 
 
 
• **YV Reddy **was the Chairman of the **Fourteenth** Finance Commission of India.
 
 
• **He is a former Governor of the Reserve Bank of India and is known for his contributions to the Indian financial sector.**
